diabetes_phase_iii.description: Reference checklist of clauses expected in a complete Phase III T2DM protocol.

gaps.name: Severe hypoglycemia exclusion
gaps.rationale: Standard exclusion for insulin-titration studies; ADA recommends excluding patients with recent severe hypoglycemia.
gaps.regulatory_reference: ADA Hypoglycemia Classification 2023; FDA Guidance for T2DM trials

gaps.name: HbA1c upper bound exclusion
gaps.rationale: Patients with HbA1c >10.5% typically require rapid intervention beyond what a comparative trial can safely provide.

gaps.name: Cardiovascular event history exclusion
gaps.rationale: Standard cardiovascular safety exclusion window for diabetes Phase III studies; required by FDA guidance for glucose-lowering agents.

gaps.name: Bariatric surgery exclusion
gaps.rationale: Bariatric procedures cause substantial changes in insulin sensitivity and gut hormones, confounding T2DM trial outcomes. Commonly omitted in first drafts.

gaps.name: Minimum T2DM duration
detection_keywords_any: diagnosed with t2dm for at least
gaps.rationale: Phase III trials of glucose-lowering agents typically require ≥6 months since T2DM diagnosis to ensure a stable disease phenotype.

gaps.name: Renal function inclusion
gaps.rationale: Renal function eligibility is required; eGFR ≥45 mL/min is the common threshold for insulin studies.

gaps.name: Pregnancy and contraception requirement
gaps.rationale: ICH M3 requires explicit pregnancy/contraception language for chronic-treatment Phase III studies.

gaps.name: Hypoglycemia adjudication committee
gaps.rationale: Standard for insulin studies; blinded adjudication of hypoglycemic events strengthens primary endpoint reliability.
gaps.regulatory_reference: FDA Guidance for industry: Diabetes Mellitus Endpoint Adjudication

gaps.name: Age eligibility criterion
gaps.rationale: A Phase III T2DM protocol must define an age-eligibility range for inclusion. Without it, the target population is undefined and IRB review will flag the omission.
gaps.regulatory_reference: ICH E6(R2); FDA Guidance for T2DM trials

gaps.name: Glycemic (HbA1c) eligibility range
gaps.rationale: Glycemic eligibility (an HbA1c inclusion range) defines the study population's baseline control. A complete T2DM protocol must specify lower and upper HbA1c bounds for entry.
gaps.regulatory_reference: EMA Diabetes Guideline 2018; FDA Guidance for glucose-lowering agents

gaps.name: Body mass index (BMI) eligibility
gaps.rationale: A Phase III T2DM protocol should define BMI eligibility bounds. BMI strongly influences insulin pharmacokinetics and the dominant T2DM phenotype, so its absence leaves the eligible population ambiguous.
gaps.regulatory_reference: ADA Standards of Care 2024; WHO obesity classification

gaps.name: Background antidiabetic therapy eligibility
gaps.rationale: The protocol must specify permitted background antidiabetic therapy (drug-naïve vs. stable background medication). Without it, the eligible population is ambiguous and screen-failure rates become unpredictable.
gaps.regulatory_reference: EMA Diabetes Guideline 2018; FDA Guidance for T2DM trials
